checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final video remains seven seconds long with original cockpit footage preserved
must.why: Output is a 10 s black-picture file; the cockpit footage is not included and the user must combine it.

must.item: Speech begins within first half-second and 'home' finishes in last half-second
must.why: The track is 10 s and the assistant says the voice should finish before 7 s, so the timing does not fit a 7 s clip.

must.item: Calm, intelligible delivery without rushed speech or artifacts
Original radio calls absent, no added music or on-screen text
must.why: The output has no original footage or audio. The picture is black with no text. Added music cannot be judged from the numbers.

exact_text.text: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.
exact_text.read_as: No text visible; frames are black. The script is spoken audio only.

faults.what: Deliverable is a 10 s black-screen file, not the 7 s cockpit clip with new voiceover.
User must do the final audio swap in an editor and trim the track themselves.
Track length of 10 s does not match the 7 s clip, and the voice timing against the 7 s mark is unverified.

summary: The agent produced only a 10-second black-screen voice track, not the requested 7-second cockpit clip with the new voiceover, so the user has to finish the job themselves.
